proposals.title: Role responsibilities for team members, with feedback per responsibility
proposals.summary: Let a team give each member named responsibilities (shot-calling, summoner spell timers, vision, objective calls) and tag lines in post-game reviews with them, so each player sees feedback grouped by what they own.

proposals.title: Suggestion chips in the game plan, from the Draft Graph
proposals.summary: Show a few suggestions in the game plan, each with a one-sentence reason from the Draft Graph's synergy and counter evidence. The team accepts or dismisses each one; dismissals are remembered per plan.

proposals.title: Season schedule with availability and a confirmed count
proposals.summary: A list of upcoming matches and scrims (next 14 days) on Match Day, with a Yes, Maybe or No from each member and a '4 of 5 confirmed' count.

proposals.title: Share a draft read-only and post it to Discord
proposals.summary: Add the draft board to share links, and let a team save one Discord webhook address so a leader can post a match's share link and a three-line summary to the team channel.

proposals.title: Review tags and a pattern count on Match Day
proposals.summary: Let each review line carry a tag (draft, lane, objectives, fights, comms), count tags over the last five reviews on Match Day, and offer 'turn into action item' on a line, with a soft cap of three open items.

proposals.title: Chalk means you: a principle for the accent colour
proposals.summary: State in the design document that the chalk accent marks what is yours (your champion, your involvement, your selected row), and review the other places where accent is only decoration.

proposals.title: Replay map on the match page as its signature moment
proposals.summary: Make the match detail page quiet except for one moment: the replay map with a shared playhead, importing the timeline the first time a match is opened.

proposals.title: Margin notes for replies and a praise count for the owner
proposals.summary: Show the team's reply to a report as a margin note in the app's serif italic voice, and add a count of praise reports to the admin hub so the owner sees what to protect.
